# lucide_icons

**Tag**: mobile

## 简介

A Lucide icon library package for Flutter applications. Fork of Feather Icons, open for anyone to contribute icons.

## 官网

- 主页: https://lucide.dev
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/lucide_icons
